fixes: Production pause captures privacy-preserving manager/worker cwd file baselines and resume reconciles actual changes with approved paths; stable out-of-bound changes reject resume.
A running child cwd may be the resolved worktree root or descendant; escapes, ambiguity, and unavailable observations reject resume.
File count, byte, and Git filename output budgets bound streaming hashes; limits, mutation during observation, special files, errors, and base-commit drift reject resume.
residual_risks: Linux peer cwd observation depends on /proc/<pid>/cwd because the OMP public port does not expose cwd; unavailable evidence fails closed.
File validation and resume are not an atomic filesystem transaction, so concurrent post-validation changes remain a TOCTOU risk.
